historical_per_sample_candidates.reason: Building IDs and dimension fields overlap, but no description/GT content hashes bind these historical scores to the frozen inputs. Matching three dimensions cannot prove full description identity; the original referenced score file is unavailable.

rq2_audit.no_api_followup: A future, explicitly specified CPU-only score protocol could score the hashed saved descriptions against the same GT, with a new provenance-bound artifact and exploratory analysis label; that would be newly derived evidence, not proof that historical scores were matched.
